title: Jeff the Land Shark: Superstar #5
desc:
MOJO'S FINAL SHOW(DOWN)!

Keepers of Jeff and Ken — Gwenpool, Kate Bishop and other Marvel heroes — show up to rescue everyone's favorite land shark from Mojo's clutches!

But what will become of the Jeff Coast Avengers? And what if Mojo wants to keep them ALL in Mojoworld FOR GOOD?

Don't miss the climactic conclusion!
